description: Retain a source-only failure triage against the pinned native SDK without new inference, imports, downloads or source changes.

findings.findings: Native tokenizer output audio is converted to Whisper features and returned with input IDs; caller uses this path with lossless decoded-source and full feature replay. No missing input_features was observed in retained receipts.
findings.limits: Static source and same-native-path replay do not establish independent reference-model semantic equivalence.

findings.findings: Native forward projects audio and masked-scatters it into configured audio token slots. The native generation helper supplies input_features on the initial cache position only, by design. The caller passes the native input dictionary directly to generate.
findings.limits: No original-weight counterfactual eager/FP32/reference-runtime execution was approved or performed; no causal numerical diagnosis.

findings.findings: Original generation config BOS1/EOS2/PAD11 matches the approved deterministic worker; all twelve first outputs genuinely ended in EOS2.
findings.limits: Complete decoding establishes no answer correctness.

findings.findings: Retained card describes audio-plus-text QA, native BF16 processor/generate usage and eight named languages without Vietnamese. No separate naturalness/MOS reviewer validation is established.
findings.limits: VI omission is a known risk and does not explain EN presence or identical-pair errors; no universal capability conclusion.

findings.findings: Both identical source/padded-waveform pairs were called SECOND; silence called YES; EN and VI speech called NO. Ten distinct source-conditioned FP32/BF16 feature hashes across twelve cases. No zero/constant-feature reuse across every case.
findings.limits: Cannot isolate prompt suitability, CPU BF16/SDPA numerical behavior or remaining native-runtime issues from one failed campaign.
